summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. (ACR) filed an 8-K updating the expected closing of its merger with ACRES Capital Corp (ACC) and internalization of its external manager. On the expected closing date of August 6, 2026, ACC will merge into ACR's subsidiary, with each ACC share converting into 2.61882 ACR common shares, issuing about 7.48 million ACR shares. The external management agreement will terminate, making ACR internally managed. ACR will also assume ACC's credit facility with $250 million capacity, of which about $185 million is expected to be outstanding. The merger agreement was filed April 30, 2026. Watch for closing completion and integration risks.
